title: DEEPBOM: Browser-Native Static Analysis of On-Device Neural Network Deployment Artifacts
description: DEEPBOM is a browser-native static analyzer for TFLite, ONNX, GGUF, SafeTensors, and Core ML deployment artifacts. It reports deterministic graph, tensor, quantization, memory, execution-provider, XNNPACK delegation, and target-fit evidence when supported by the serialized artifact and source-pinned rules, while keeping runtime-dependent claims explicit. This record provides a persistent, versioned citation and provenance identity for the hosted software. Implementation source, executable artifacts, protected WebAssembly, production credentials, and model files are not included in this deposit.
access_conditions: Files are retained as a restricted release-provenance dossier. The deposited files do not include implementation source or executables. Research collaboration or independent review access may be considered separately by the rights holder.
